title.narrative: Development of 200 ecovillages in Burkina Faso

description.narrative: Development of "200 Climate-smart ecovillage projects in Burkina Faso"funding proposal to mobilize USD 40 million in grant financing from Green Climate Fund. The indicative total project cost (GCF + co-financing) is USD 70 million.

The eco-villages projectaims to increase the resilience of rural agricultural populations, infrastructure and to reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. It also aims at testing and disseminating a model of ecological villages in Burkina Faso that will contribute to a paradigm shift towards resilient and low-carbon production and consumption patterns in 200 villages. The specific objectives of the project are to: (i) strengthen the capacity of local authorities to exercise their full competences and to pilot the Sustainable Human Development at the local level; (ii) promote climate-smart socio-economic infrastructure and community resilience; and (iii) promote renewable energy.
